mapper.select: select c.TYPE as orgType, c.TITLE as orgName, b.ID as assetId, b.NAME as assetName, b.IP as assetIp1, b.IP2 as assetIp2, b.ASSET_MODE as assetMode, a.id as alarmId, a.TYPE as alarmType, a.TITLE, a.ALARM_LEVEL as alarmLevel, a.content, a.description, a.ALARM_CODE as alarmCode, a.OCCUR_TIME as occurTime, a.CONFIRM_TIME as confirmTime, a.confirmor as confirmor, a.ALARM_TO_RECORD as alarmToRecord, a.opinion, a.remark, a.blank, a.status, a.ALARM_STATE as alarmState from ALARM_INFO a left join ASSET b on a.ASSET_ID = b.ID left join sys_org c on b.ORG_ID = c.ID where a.id = #{alarmId}
